summary: P69B booking-fee-as-separate-payment feature + cash pricing sheet KPR-hide tested end-to-end. 8/8 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend flows verified for owner (booking-fee-panel with pay dialog, PDF buttons, deal-pricing-sheet with booking-fee-panel embedded, KPR-vs-cash toggling) and manager (pay button hidden with 'Pencatatan pembayaran oleh Keuangan.' hint). Setting gate on booking_fee.require_paid_before_booking verified (OFF permits book with unpaid, ON blocks with 'belum LUNAS' and passes after full pay). Cancel of unpaid deal closes invoice as expected.

minor.issue: Response body of reserve does not include booking_fee_status/booking_fee_invoice_id — those fields are set on the deal by bf.create_invoice AFTER the local deal dict is returned. Callers must GET the deal to see them. Consider re-reading the deal (or updating the dict) before returning so the response matches the DB state.

ui_bugs.issue: Receipt PDF button called wrong endpoint `/ar/receipts/{id}/pdf` — the router prefix is `/finance/ar`. Fixed inline (changed to `/finance/ar/receipts/{id}/pdf`).

integration_issues.flow: Deal pricing sheet — cash scheme hide-KPR
integration_issues.issue: Backend pricing_snapshot stored scheme.type = scheme.get('type') but payment_schemes documents only carry `kind` (e.g. cash_keras/cash_bertahap/kpr) — never `type`. Result: `pricing.scheme.type` was always null and DealPricingSheet's isCash check never triggered, so KPR box was shown for cash deals and cash-note was never shown. Fixed inline in quotation_engine.py line 188 to fallback to scheme.get('kind').

action_items: Consider re-fetching (or manually setting) booking_fee_status + booking_fee_invoice_id on the deal dict returned by POST /api/deals/reserve so the response reflects DB state (currently caller must issue an extra GET).

Verify the two applied fixes are appropriate long-term: (a) BookingFeePanel receipt PDF path changed from `/ar/receipts/{id}/pdf` to `/finance/ar/receipts/{id}/pdf`; (b) quotation_engine.pricing_snapshot now uses scheme.get('kind') as fallback for scheme.type. Alternative: normalise the DB (add `type` column to payment_schemes) or update DealPricingSheet.js to check `scheme.kind`.
Consider surfacing a `lead-deal-booking-fee-status` also on /customers?hub=deal Deals list (DealsListTab shows the label but has no data-testid on the pill).
critical_code_review_comments: quotation_engine.pricing_snapshot: schemes DB uses `kind` not `type`. Snapshot fell back to null, silently breaking every cash-vs-kpr UI decision that reads pricing.scheme.type. Fixed with kind fallback, but the two names should be reconciled once.

BookingFeePanel used a wrong AR receipts URL (missing /finance prefix) — receipt PDF was 404. Fixed. Same pattern is used correctly elsewhere in the codebase (ArPanel, DocumentIssueHub) — good grep target for future components.

sales_reserve.reserve returns a stale local dict — booking_fee_status is mutated on the DB by booking_fee.create_invoice but never reflected in the returned deal. Downstream code (and tests) relying on the response cannot see it without a re-fetch.

block_booking_reason correctly gates POST /deals/{id}/book on the setting, and pay/cancel state transitions are covered by tests. RBAC on booking-fee-router is well-scoped (finance:create for pay, deals:view for GETs, site denied).

rca of the issue: 1) Receipt-PDF 404: BookingFeePanel used /ar/... not /finance/ar/... — off-by-a-prefix relative to ar_router (prefix `/finance/ar`). 2) KPR-hide never worked: pricing_snapshot stored `scheme.type = scheme.get('type')` but payment_scheme documents use `kind`. All DealPricingSheet cash-scheme UI depended on this being 'cash_keras' or 'cash_bertahap'.
